title_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Significance (Episode 75)
description_en: Hadith al-Thaqalayn: Its Chain of Transmission and Significance (Episode 75), an episode of the program Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: This session explores further aspects of the transmission and meaning of Hadith al-Thaqalayn within the Mahdist discourse.
